full_judgment: 6. It appears that previously the plaintiffs brought Title Suit No. 296 of 1956 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Pirojpur in respect of the suit land for recovery of khas possession and the pattan nama in the name of the defendants was challenged in the suit. The suit was dismissed on 26.11.1959. After lapse of 40 years, the present suit was instituted. The High Court Division held that the suit was hopelessly barred by limitation. The appellate court being the last court of fact also held the same view.
